findings_qualitative.value: Eight CO clouds along X-ray shell; clouds A, B, F, G show R(3-2/1-0)>1.2 and are shock-heated

evidence.quote: The four molecular clouds A, B, F, and G show high intensity ratios of $R_\mathrm{CO32/CO10} > 1.2$ without infrared sources and/or massive stars.

claims.hypothesis: GMC LIRS 36A is heated by UV from LIN 78 rather than the SNR
claims.experiment: LVG analysis with ALMA 12CO/13CO(2-1) and ASTE 12CO(3-2)
claims.finding: High Tkin is due to the massive exciting star LIN 78

evidence.quote: The high kinematic temperature is, therefore, due to the heating by the massive exciting star LIN 78 in the Hii region DEM S23.
